review.algorithm_assessment: The y-coordinate cancels when comparing distances to bowls on y=0; ties go to the left bowl. Prefix cat counts at adjacent chosen-bowl midpoints determine each load. For a selected final bowl, the largest feasible incoming prefix count dominates all smaller ones for extensions. Binary-search the maximum load with an O(M^2) feasibility DP; any bowl can be first and the final suffix is explicitly checked.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
